a2aPollInterval: poll interval must be 1s to 30s and no greater than task timeout
a2aRequestTimeout: request timeout must be at most five minutes
a2aTaskTimeout: task timeout must be between 1s and 5m
a2aTenant: tenant must be valid UTF-8 without control characters and at most 256 bytes
a2aToken: token must contain printable ASCII without spaces and at most 8192 bytes
a2aURL: A2A requires a bounded HTTPS URL without credentials, query or fragment; cleartext HTTP requires explicit opt-in
amqpURL: an amqp or amqps URL with a valid optional numeric port is required
autoIgnoreCount: automatic Ignore requires an incident count between 2 and 1000
autoIgnoreWindow: automatic Ignore requires a positive Go duration of at most 720h
awsOperation: only the reboot-instance operation is supported
certificateThresholds: warning days must be at least critical days when both thresholds are enabled
cleartextTLSConflict: cleartext transport cannot also configure certificate settings
conflict: A resource version changed; reload and review the intended changes.
connectionSyntax: connection string has invalid syntax or contradictory options
counterRange: value must be between zero and 2147483647
credentialConflict: a credential reference and an inline value cannot select the same field
credentialField: credential reference selects an unsupported driver field
credentialRequired: this field must use a credentialRefs reference
credentialValue: supply a credential value; redaction placeholders are not values
cron: a valid five-field maintenance cron expression is required
dnsServer: server must be a host or IP address with an optional numeric port
dockerOperationBudget: Docker operation timeout must allow stop grace plus 20s and be at most 24h
dockerStopBudget: Docker stop grace must leave 20s within the maximum 24h operation budget
driverTypeConflict: target type conflicts with the selected recovery driver
duplicateField: a field is specified more than once
duplicateIdentity: A resource identity occurs more than once.
emailAddress: a valid email address is required
emailAddresses: one or more valid email addresses are required
explicitTLS: select config.tls explicitly when certificate settings are supplied
externalFailureProtocol: External check rules require a versioned structured-failure contract.
failureCode: Use registered failure codes or terminal dot-delimited prefixes applicable to this check driver.
failureMatcher: Use bounded, distinct protocol values and compatible phases for the selected codes.
failureObservation: The observation must contain only fields and values allowed by its versioned failure code.
failureTaxonomy: Specify a supported failure taxonomy version for rules.
grpcHealthSettings: gRPC service and certificate settings require health mode
grpcMode: gRPC mode must be tcp or health
hostPort: a host and numeric port are required
httpHeaders: headers must contain valid HTTP field names and values without line breaks
httpMethod: method must be a valid HTTP method token
httpStatus: expected statuses must be between 100 and 599
httpURL: an HTTP or HTTPS URL with a host is required
httpsRequired: HTTP certificate settings require an HTTPS URL
invalidGraph: The collection cannot be validated against the observed catalog.
invalidIdentity: identity is empty or contains unsupported characters
invalidReference: reference is empty, invalid or repeated
invalidResource: The resource schema, compiled driver or configuration is invalid.
invalidTLSName: TLS trust path or server name contains unsupported characters
invalidType: value has the wrong type for this field
kubernetesKind: only the deployment recovery kind is supported
logDirectoryRequired: file notifications require notifications.log_directory in the runtime configuration
logPath: file must be a portable relative name inside the configured notification log directory
maintenanceDuration: maintenance duration must be positive and at most 366 days
minimumInterval: check interval must be at least 5ms
missingReference: a referenced resource does not exist in the complete configuration
mongoURI: a mongodb URI with valid seed hosts is required; SRV discovery is unsupported
mysqlTLSTCP: MySQL TLS requires a tcp, tcp4 or tcp6 network
namedTarget: a nonempty target without control line breaks is required
networkHost: a host name or IP address without a path or whitespace is required
noTLSSettings: this check has no TLS certificate settings
nodeLimit: configuration nesting or alias expansion exceeds its limit
nonemptyReferences: at least one notification destination reference is required
nonnegativeDuration: a nonnegative Go duration string is required
notificationColor: notification colors must be red, yellow, cyan, green, gray or blue
notificationDestination: select one supported notification destination form
notificationDestinationConflict: a notification group cannot be combined with inline notification settings
notificationTrigger: notification trigger is unsupported or requires red with a recovery action
notifyTypeRequired: recipient routing requires a notification driver type
optionalPortRange: port must be zero for the default or between 1 and 65535
positiveDuration: a positive Go duration string is required, for example 60s
postgresSSLMode: sslmode must be disable, allow, prefer, require, verify-ca or verify-full
postgresTLSTCP: PostgreSQL TLS requires a TCP host, not a Unix socket
pushoverColorPriority: per-color priorities require supported notification colors and values -2..2
pushoverEmergency: priority must be -2..2; emergency retry must be zero or at least 30s and expiry zero or at most 10800s
recoveryChoice: Configure either one recovery driver or ordered rules, never both.
recoveryTimeout: recovery timeout must be a nonnegative Go duration no greater than 24h; zero selects the driver default
redisAddress: address must be a host with a numeric port or an absolute Unix socket path
redisTLSTCP: Redis TLS requires a TCP address
referenceNotFound: reference must identify an existing nonempty notification destination
ruleDecision: Choose exactly one intervention driver or an explicit none: true decision.
ruleIdentity: Use a unique rule ID of at most 64 ASCII letters, digits, underscores or hyphens, starting with a letter.
ruleLimit: Configure between one and 32 intervention rules.
skipVerificationCAConflict: a CA file cannot be combined with disabled certificate verification; remove the CA file or enable verification
systemdMode: mode is not a supported systemd job mode
systemdUnit: a unit name without a path or line breaks is required
telegramDestinationConflict: test mode and a custom URL cannot be combined
timezone: a supported time zone is required
tlsPolicyConflict: connection-string options conflict with the typed TLS policy; use one consistent transport and certificate policy
unknownField: an unsupported field is present; check the schema for this object
unknownRecoveryDestination: Uncertain recovery has no enabled blue notification destination. Its action will remain held for operator review.
unknownYAMLAlias: YAML alias has no preceding definition in this document
unreachableRule: This rule cannot match because earlier rules cover every matching observation.
unsafePrefix: Dependency-first application would invalidate an existing consumer.
unsupportedDriver: this driver is not supported by the selected build
victoropsDestination: supply a URL or both the REST endpoint key and routing key
victoropsMessageType: message type must be CRITICAL, WARNING, ACKNOWLEDGEMENT, INFO or RECOVERY
yamlExpansionLimit: YAML aliases exceed the expansion or retained-anchor limit, contain a cycle, or exceed nesting depth
partialOverlap: This rule partially overlaps an earlier rule. Only observations not already matched can select it.
recoveryOnlyCoverage: Red is configured only for confirmed recovery failure. No-action or unmatched failures do not trigger red; unknown recovery requires an explicit blue destination.
